text: しんかしたら　２のしまで　ゲーム　やるんだもん

structure.jp: ゲーム　やるんだもん
structure.en: I'm going to play the game, so there

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら means 'when' or 'if': once the first thing happens, the next follows. しんかしたら = 'when it evolves'.

patterns.name: 〜もん
patterns.explanation: もん at the end is a childish way to insist on your reason, like 'because I am!'. やるんだもん = 'because I'm going to play!'.
